## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `Projects`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `projects`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **Projects**.

## Step 2: Create a project

1. In the organization overview page, select **+ Create** to create a new project from scratch. :::tip To import an existing project from a Git repository instead, click **Import**. See Import a project for instructions. :::
2. <!-- manual: Fill in the project details: -->
3. <!-- manual: Optionally, connect a Git repository to embed repository metadata with the project. To import integrations from a repository rather than just linking metadata, use the [Import a project](../../deploy/cloud/import-project.md) flow instead. -->
4. Select **Create**.

## Step 3: Edit a project

1. <!-- manual: From the project home, go to Admin › Settings. -->
2. <!-- manual: Update the Name or Description as needed by clicking the respective fields. -->
3. <!-- manual: Save your changes. -->

## Step 4: Remove a project

1. <!-- manual: From the project home, go to Admin › Settings. -->
2. Select **Remove Project** on the right side of the page.
3. <!-- manual: Enter the project name to confirm, then click Remove. -->
